parsed.headline: Review needed: in-person visit within 6 months not documented.
parsed.explanation: The record does not show whether 'Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1-4) above are met; and,' as required by policy.
